definitions: Each of four parts of a circle, plane, or sphere divided by two lines or planes at right angles.
An instrument formerly used in astronomy and navigation for measuring altitudes, typically consisting of a graduated arc of 90 degrees with a sighting mechanism.
A quarter of a circle or of its circumference.
examples: The graph is in the first quadrant.
He used a quadrant to measure the star's altitude.
The architect drew a quadrant on the plan.
